EuroDigital — Vancouver Island, BC (Canada)

EuroDigital is a Vancouver Island studio for modern websites and small apps: clear messaging, fast pages, local SEO basics, and handoffs clients can run themselves. Scoped builds first; ongoing retainers only by agreement.

Primary work:
- Small business and trades lead-generation websites
- Mobile app builds (example: NoteBill — AI-assisted invoicing on Google Play)
- Ecommerce and catalog-style storefronts
- Launch support and practical project handoff

Location:
- Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada
